extraction.name: EuroSAT
extraction.description: A novel dataset based on Sentinel-2 satellite images covering 13 spectral bands and consisting out of 10 classes with in total 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced images.
extraction.creator: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Satellite images of European cities distributed across 34 countries were gathered to create a dataset of 27,000 georeferenced and labeled image patches.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Images full of snow, ice, clouds, or dead pixels were discarded as they did not show the intended classes.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Satellite images taken by the Sentinel-2A satellite, specifically choosing images associated with cities covered in the European Urban Atlas.
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: Bands with a lower spatial resolution have been upsampled to 10 meters per pixel using cubic-spline interpolation.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Spectral bands with a lower spatial resolution were upsampled to 10 meters per pixel using cubic-spline interpolation.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were manually checked to sort out mislabeled images and images full of snow or ice. Images with a color cast due to lack of atmospheric correction were intentionally kept in the dataset.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The classes and their relationships were based on the mapping guide of the European Urban Atlas. The 27,000 images were manually checked multiple times to correct the ground truth and sort out mislabeled images.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: All 27,000 images were manually checked multiple times to correct the ground truth by sorting out mislabeled images and images full of snow or ice.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset enables Earth observation applications that are beneficial for urban area development, nature protection, and sustainable development, such as detecting deforestation to monitor climate change.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The geographic distribution of the dataset is influenced by the number of represented cities per country in the European Urban Atlas.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset lacks atmospheric correction, which can result in images with a color cast. Furthermore, the 64x64 image patch size does not allow for finely graduated per-pixel segmentation.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and testing deep Convolutional Neural Networks for land use and land cover classification, detecting land use and land cover changes, and assisting in keeping geographical maps up-to-date.
